description: Replacing every retained argument by a congruent term preserves the relation-map truth value on its tuple of classes.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.relationMap_coherent.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Problem L) {n : ℕ} (R : L.Relations n)
  (ts us : Fin n → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L)
  (ht : ∀ (i : Fin n), ts i ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.support Γ)
  (hu : ∀ (i : Fin n), us i ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.support Γ)
  (h : ∀ (i : Fin n), (ts i, us i) ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.closure Γ) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.relationMap Γ R fun i =>
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.classOf Γ (ts i) ⋯) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.relationMap Γ R fun i =>
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.classOf Γ (us i) ⋯
